title: Cardinality of the root cube
statement: Let $K$ be a finite field and let $\omega \in K$ with $\omega \ne 1$. Then the root cube $\{1,\omega\}^n$, consisting of those vectors $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to K$ with $x_i \in \{1,\omega\}$ for every coordinate $i$, has exactly $2^n$ elements.
replaced:
If $\omega \ne 1$ and $K$ is finite, then the root cube has exactly $2^n$ points:
$\abs{\{1,\omega\}^n} = 2^n$.
